description:
Who We Are: 

 Exiger is the AI partner for supply chain and procurement automation. Its centralized 1EXIGER.AI platform allows organizations to manage their entire operating network, from parts to suppliers, regulators, and customers, through an autonomous agentic workforce that learns, adapts, and augments with every decision. The AI-native platform, combined with the largest supply chain knowledge asset, empowers 550+ global customers, including 150 Fortune 500 and 80+ government and defense industrial organizations, to act first. Exiger is FedRAMP® authorized and a 2x Leader in Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Supplier Risk Management.

 Forward Deployed Engineer 

 Location: Huntsville, Alabama 

 Work Environment: Hybrid 

 Clearance Required: Active Top Secret (TS) with SCI Eligibility 

  

 Role Summary: 

 Exiger is transforming how governments and global enterprises manage supply chain, defense, and geopolitical risk. Our AI-powered platform equips the world’s most important institutions with the intelligence they need to protect critical infrastructure, secure national interests, and make data-driven operational decisions.

 From identifying counterfeit parts in defense supply chains to anticipating geopolitical risk exposure, Exiger enables mission owners to act with clarity and confidence in complex, high-stakes environments.

 Forward Deployed AI Engineers work directly with government and defense customers to understand their most complex operational challenges and design and implement AI-driven solutions to solve them.

 Our customers rely on Exiger’s platform to support mission-critical operations — often beginning with open-ended questions such as:

 
 “Where are vulnerabilities hidden in our supply chain?”

 “How can we proactively detect and mitigate risk before it impacts readiness?”

 “How do we modernize fragmented legacy systems into a unified intelligence capability?”

 
 As a Forward Deployed AI Engineer, you will combine engineering depth, AI/ML expertise, and mission understanding to deliver scalable, production-grade solutions that drive measurable real-world impact.

 You will operate at the intersection of engineering, data science, and mission delivery — embedded alongside customer stakeholders and internal teams. Working in small, high-trust teams, you will own projects end-to-end — from architecture and data ingestion through model deployment, integration, and executive-level briefings.

 You will not just build models — you will ensure they function reliably in production, under real-world operational constraints.

 What You'll Do: 

 
 Design, implement, and maintain scalable data pipelines for ingesting, cleansing, and transforming supply chain and risk-related datasets.

 Apply AI/ML methods to enhance predictive analytics, anomaly detection, and risk identification within SCRM workflows.

 Integrate AI-driven analytics into Exiger’s SaaS platform through APIs, data services, and system interfaces.

 Partner with program directors, data scientists, and software engineers to operationalize models into production systems.

 Cleanse and enrich customer provided data.

 Develop and maintain dashboards, data visualizations, and reporting solutions to enable decision-making by senior government stakeholders.

 Ensure quality, integrity, and security of data across all program implementations.

 Support delivery of transformation projects by modernizing customer data environments and enabling advanced risk analytics.

 Contribute to agile delivery cycles, from design and testing through deployment.

 Periodically provide updates on data pipelines, AI performance metrics, and customer value realization.

 
 What You Need: 

 
 Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, Data Engineering, Artificial Intelligence, or related technical field.

 5+ years of experience in data engineering, applied AI/ML, or scalable system integration

 Demonstrated experience operationalizing AI models beyond experimentation

 An Active Top Secret Clearance with SCI eligibility

 Deep proficiency in Python and SQL, with experience designing scalable data architectures

 Experience building and deploying AI/ML systems in production environments

 Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS, Snowflake, Redshift) and secure system integration

 Ability to translate ambiguous mission problems into structured technical solutions

 Comfort working directly with senior government stakeholders

 Strong systems thinking across data pipelines, APIs, models, and visualization layers

 Ability to operate independently in dynamic, high-stakes environments

 Willingness to travel as needed to support customer engagements

 
 Why You'll Love Working at Exiger: 

 
 High-performance culture rooted in accountability, collaboration, and a shared commitment to excellence.

 Discretionary Time Off for all employees, with no maximum limits on time off

 Industry leading health, vision, and dental benefits

 Competitive compensation package

 16 weeks of fully paid parental leave

 Flexible, hybrid approach to working from home and in the office where applicable

 Focus on wellness and employee health through stipends and dedicated wellness programming

 Purposeful career development programs with reimbursement provided for educational certifications

 
 #LI-hybrid

  
 Exiger is named a Leader in the Gartner ®  Magic Quadrant™ for Supplier Risk Management, twice selected as one of Fast Company's 'Brands That Matter,' and recipient of the Third Party Risk Association's Innovator Award, Exiger's technology has been recognized by leading analyst evaluations and 50+ awards. Learn more at  Exiger.com  and follow Exiger on  LinkedIn .

 At Exiger, our values define how we work and why we lead. We are mission-inspired, imagination-driven, trust-anchored, and compassion-focused—committed to building technology that makes the world safer, more transparent, and more resilient.

 All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability or protected veteran status, or any other legally protected basis, in accordance with applicable law.

 Exiger’s hybrid work policy is periodically reviewed and adjusted to align with evolving business needs.
